title: The raincoat photographer
alt: A photographer in a yellow raincoat holds a green umbrella on a rainy street.
description: A cinematic portrait with coherent hands, camera strap and wet street detail.
prompt: A richly detailed street-fashion portrait of an adult East Asian man in a mustard-yellow raincoat standing under a dark green umbrella on a rainy old street. His hand naturally grips the umbrella handle; a compact camera hangs on a continuous strap against his chest. Rain beads, wet cobblestones, textured stone walls and warm shop-window light create cinematic depth. Coherent umbrella construction and human anatomy, no legible signage.
